title: Letnev can lower its fleet pool below two
description: A command-token redistribution never offered an arrangement with fewer than two tokens in the fleet pool (a guard against policies that empty it), so Letnev, whose Armada allows two more ships per system than its fleet pool, could not go lower. From rules version 4 the engine also offers fleet 0 and 1 to Letnev (other factions keep the floor of two), and the panel names the floor it reads from the offered arrangements instead of a hard-coded 2. Before shots use the option set the engine offered before the fix; after shots the new one. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: fleet 1, desktop
shots.caption: Fleet lowered to 1: 'Keep at least 2 tokens in the fleet pool' and Confirm is disabled.

shots.heading: After: fleet 0, desktop
shots.caption: Fleet lowered to 0 for Letnev: no blocker, Confirm is enabled.

shots.heading: After: fleet 0, phone
shots.caption: Fleet 0 can be confirmed on a phone.
